highlights:
Sales-to-Implementation Handover: Streamlines the transition from sales to implementation.
Kickoff Deck Generator: Generates customer kickoff presentations.
Workshop Planner: Prepares workshop sessions and generates post-session recaps.
Solution Design Agent: Generates solution design documents for each customer.
UAT Agent: Creates test scripts and test cases from design documents, scope documents, emails, and call transcripts.
Form-to-Sheets Agent: Transfers form responses into Rocketlane Sheets for reporting.

Problem: Native settings, notifications, and automations were configured manually after every design document.
Solution: Built a Nitro Workforce agent that reads design documents and determines the required configuration.
Browser Automation: Uses Browserbase to navigate Rocketlane, configure settings, and create automations.
Validation: Proof of concept subsequently validated by the product team.

Knowledge Capture: Extracts customer use cases, requirements, and discussed solutions from Avoma call transcripts and Freshdesk tickets.
AI-Powered Solution Generation: Uses product documentation and relevant knowledge to propose solutions when none were discussed, keeping proposed approaches distinct from agreed solutions.
Human-in-the-Loop Approval: Implementation Managers review, approve, or revise generated use cases and solutions before they become reusable knowledge.
Searchable Knowledge Base: Built with Lovable, Anthropic-hosted and backend agents, and Supermemory to retrieve relevant approved solutions without loading the entire documentation corpus into the LLM.
Current-State Validation: Checks historical solutions against Notion, Slack, Rocketlane projects, and product and API documentation to identify retired features and outdated approaches.
Feedback & Continuous Improvement: Caches repeat answers when relevance is 95% or higher, captures user ratings, and uses a validator agent to classify incorrect answers and route them to an admin review queue.
On-site in Saudi Arabia for a half-million-dollar engagement and in the UK for MHA — requirement gathering, stakeholder workshops, and go-live training.
Converted pilots into full-scale enterprise rollouts through structured discovery and early value demonstration — $350K+ in expansion value.
Built a use-case-driven implementation framework with complexity scoring and effort models — so pre-sales could scope accurately, auto-calculate timelines, and cut BRD and UAT ambiguity.
Spotted unbilled scope changes, built a way to track them, and worked with Sales to introduce pre-purchased Professional Services credits — turning informal changes into billable work.
projectDescriptions: Turns customer calls, tickets, Slack, and project docs into human-approved implementation solutions. AI-powered assistant that lets support teams query enterprise platform configurations in natural language — eliminating dependency on implementation engineers post go-live.
